footer.zh: MaaS 代币 · 国际简介

eyebrow.zh: 华为云 · 国际产品简介

subtitle.zh: 面向企业 AI 的 Model-as-a-Service 代币消费：可预期计量、可治理用量、可扩展结算。
subtitle.en: Model-as-a-Service token consumption for enterprise AI — predictable metering, governed usage, and scalable settlement.

notes.zh: 开场对准海外平台、采购与 AI 工程买家：强调计量透明与治理，不承诺未核实的单价或 SLA。
notes.en: Open for overseas platform, procurement, and AI engineering buyers. Lead with metering clarity and governance — no unverified unit prices or SLAs.

subtitle.zh: 价值、计量闭环、单位结构、买家视角，再到下一步行动。
subtitle.en: Value, metering loop, unit structure, buyer lenses, then next steps.

notes.zh: 高管精简切面会隐藏本页；完整版用于发现会对齐。
notes.en: Hidden on the executive cut. Use the full deck to align discovery workshops.

label.zh: 企业为何按代币消费模型服务
label.en: Why enterprises buy model access by token

label.zh: 请求 → 计量 → 结算闭环
计费单位与结构占位（非官方价）
label.en: Billing units & structure placeholders (not list price)

label.zh: 平台 / 采购 / AI 工程讲法
label.en: Platform, procurement, and AI engineering tracks

label.zh: 发现会或用量估算范围确认

subtitle.zh: 用可讲解的计量与治理结果说话；区域价目与 SLA 以正式商务材料为准。
subtitle.en: Lead with briefable metering and governance outcomes. Regional list prices and SLAs stay in formal commercial materials.

notes.zh: 三块：可预期计量、企业治理、规模扩展；不要编造节省百分比或官方单价。
notes.en: Three beats: predictable metering, enterprise governance, scale. Do not invent savings % or official unit prices.

body.zh: 按输入 / 输出代币等可观测单位计量，便于预算、对账与用量趋势沟通。
body.en: Meter against observable units such as input and output tokens — clearer budgets, reconciliation, and usage trends.

body.zh: 围绕账号、配额、审计与结算边界组织用量，支持组织级管控对话。
body.en: Organize usage around accounts, quotas, auditability, and settlement boundaries for org-level control conversations.

body.zh: 同一计量叙事可覆盖试点到量产；容量与区域可用性以正式方案确认为准。
body.en: One metering narrative from pilot to production. Capacity and regional availability confirm in the formal proposal.

subtitle.zh: 对外可讲解的计量闭环；具体计费字段与账期以正式产品说明为准。
subtitle.en: A briefable metering loop. Exact billable fields and billing cycles confirm in formal product documentation.

notes.zh: 四步：调用请求 → 代币计量 → 账目汇总 → 账单结算；不要展开内部计费引擎细节。
notes.en: Walk four beats: invoke, meter tokens, aggregate, settle. Skip internal billing-engine detail.

body.zh: 应用或工作流调用 MaaS 端点，携带组织与项目上下文。
body.en: Apps or workflows call a MaaS endpoint with org and project context.

body.zh: 按约定单位记录输入 / 输出等可计费用量。
body.en: Record billable usage in agreed units such as input and output tokens.

body.zh: 按账号、项目或成本中心汇总用量，支持对账与配额审视。
body.en: Roll up usage by account, project, or cost center for reconciliation and quota review.

body.zh: 进入组织约定的结算路径；商务条款以合同与价目表为准。
body.en: Enter the org's agreed settlement path. Commercial terms follow contract and price sheet.

result.zh: 结果：一条可讲解的代币消费闭环——请求可观测、用量可对账、结算可治理。
result.en: Outcome: a briefable token-consumption loop — observable requests, reconcilable usage, governable settlement.

subtitle.zh: 说明计量维度与单位，非官方华为价目。正式单价请以区域价目表 / 报价为准。
subtitle.en: Explains metering dimensions and units — not an official Huawei price list. Confirm unit rates on the regional price sheet / quote.

notes.zh: 所有金额单元格均为 [占位]；演示时强调结构，引导客户走正式报价。
notes.en: All amount cells are [Placeholder]. Brief the structure; route customers to a formal quote.

rows.zh: 提示词 / 上下文消耗
可复用上下文的计量档位

note.zh: 本表仅展示计量结构。任何数字费率、折扣与 SLA 均须经产品市场 / 商务正式确认后方可对外。
note.en: Structure only. Any numeric rates, discounts, or SLAs require product marketing / commercial confirmation before customer use.

subtitle.zh: 按角色切换讲法；区域价目、合规与合同条款以正式方案为准。
subtitle.en: Switch the story by role. Regional price sheets, compliance, and contract terms confirm in the formal proposal.

notes.zh: 用页签切换 Platform / Procurement / AI Engineering；高管精简切面隐藏本页。
notes.en: Tab through Platform / Procurement / AI Engineering. Hidden on the executive cut.

body.zh: 关心可嵌入性与可观测用量：代币应进入现有成本与配额体系，而不是另起影子账本。
body.en: Embeddability and observable usage matter: tokens should land in existing cost and quota systems, not a shadow ledger.

bullets.zh: 按项目 / 账号汇总用量，便于平台对账
bullets.en: Roll up usage by project / account for platform reconciliation

bullets.zh: 计量事件可对齐现有观测与配额策略
bullets.en: Align metering events with existing observability and quota policy

bullets.zh: [占位] 集成清单与区域端点以架构评审为准
bullets.en: [Placeholder] Integrations and regional endpoints confirm in architecture review

body.zh: 关心单位清晰、账期可预期、合同可审计：先对齐计量结构，再谈正式报价。
body.en: Clear units, predictable billing cycles, and auditable contracts matter. Align metering structure before formal quotes.

bullets.zh: 输入 / 输出等单位可讲解、可对账
bullets.en: Input / output units stay briefable and reconcilable

bullets.zh: [占位] 单价、折扣与币种：区域价目表 / 报价
bullets.en: [Placeholder] Unit rates, discounts, and currency: regional price sheet / quote

bullets.zh: [占位] 账期、开票与 SLA：不以本页承诺
bullets.en: [Placeholder] Billing cycle, invoicing, and SLAs: not committed on this slide

body.zh: 关心提示成本可控与实验到量产路径：同一计量叙事覆盖试点与生产。
body.en: Controllable prompt cost and a pilot-to-production path matter. One metering narrative covers both.

bullets.zh: 按请求观测输入 / 输出消耗，支撑提示优化
bullets.en: Observe input / output per request to support prompt optimization

bullets.zh: 试点配额与生产配额可用同一套单位沟通
bullets.en: Pilot and production quotas share the same unit language

bullets.zh: [占位] 模型目录与上下文上限：确认产品说明
bullets.en: [Placeholder] Model catalog and context limits: confirm in product docs

vision.zh:
把数字世界带入每个人、每个家庭、
每个组织，构建万物互联的智能世界。
vision.en:
Bring digital to every person, home and organization
for a fully connected, intelligent world.

notes.zh: 收尾邀请下一步：发现会 / 用量估算范围确认；单价与 SLA 不在本页承诺。
notes.en: Close with next step: discovery workshop or usage-estimate scope. No unit-price or SLA commitments on this slide.
